world_news_real.title: Trump confirms he asked Fifa to review Balogun ban
world_news_real.description: United States President Donald Trump says Fifa "made the right decision" to suspend Folarin Balogun's one-match ban, adding that otherwise, it would have left a "big stain" on the World Cup.

world_news_real.title: Ukraine warns of interceptor missile shortage as 21 killed in Kyiv region
world_news_real.description: President Zelensky says Sunday's "massive Russian attack" on Kyiv consisted of 68 missiles and 351 strike drones.

world_news_real.title: Huge crowds fill Tehran streets for Khamenei's funeral procession
world_news_real.description: Many people were waving Iranian flags and red banners symbolising vengeance for the former supreme leader's war death.

world_news_real.title: Wildfire in southern France forces evacuation of 10,000 people
world_news_real.description: Tour de France organisers ban spectators from stage three as a wildfire hits the Pyrénées-Orientales region.

world_news_real.title: 'I ate ketchup and cheese,' says Venezuelan girl trapped under quake rubble for 32 hours
world_news_real.description: Fabiana was trapped in the rubble of a 10-storey residential building after two earthquakes rocked Venezuela in June.

world_news_real.title: Sri Lanka prison riots leave 26 dead and more than 100 injured
world_news_real.description: The two days of violence at Negombo Prison are the worst prison riots in the country in years.

world_news_real.title: Marine Le Pen appeal verdict: Why this moment matters for France
world_news_real.description: The leader of France's National Rally leads the opinion polls ahead of the 2027 presidential election and will now find out if she can stand.

world_news_real.title: Australian PM apologises for 'inappropriate' comments about Kylie Minogue
world_news_real.description: Albanese has apologised 'unequivocally' after his remarks prompted a backlash.

world_news_real.title: Super Typhoon Bavi makes landfall on US Pacific islands with huge wind gusts
world_news_real.description: The storm, with winds of nearly 290km/h (180mph) and gusts of 350km/h, is lashing the island of Rota.

world_news_real.title: Australia space agency has found 'likely source' of mystery space balls
world_news_real.description: The agency says that they "appear to be pressure vessels from a space launch vehicle".
